slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any additional constraints or requirements beyond the ones already stated, such as limits on how many days per week a student can work, restrictions on consecutive days, or requirements that certain students must be available on specific days?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent's catch-all explicitly names a limit on how many days per week a student can work, which directly matches the H1 meaning; the follow-up at turn 9 also confirms the 2-day interpretation.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a daily cap on the number of distinct students assigned to duty. The daily limit was only surfaced because the simulator volunteered it in response to a vague catch-all that did not target this slot, and volunteer reveals receive no credit.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the scheduling plan — are we minimizing total weekly labor cost, minimizing total hours worked, or something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective, directly covering the minimize-gross-pay goal.

stopping_behavior.rationale: H3 (P0) and H1 (P1) were addressed by explicit questions, but H2 (P1) was never asked about and was obtained only via a volunteered reveal, so it remains unresolved by the hit-based standard when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent cleanly recovered the objective (H3) and the per-student weekly day limit (H1) through targeted questions, but never specifically probed the daily distinct-student cap (H2), receiving it only because the simulator volunteered it; it also looped READY_TO_MODEL many times after reaching a final state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
